lede: UCF carries the stronger underlying team rating — +4.9 against +2.2, a 2.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it UCF +2.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with TCU winning 57% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where UCF leads TCU by 87 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 86% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
